{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Tex-Mex cuisine|Tex-Mex cuisine]]

The Mexican dish '''picadillo''' is a popular filling for [[Cookbook:Taco|tacos]].

==Ingredients==
*1–1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] (450–625 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]
*1 large yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*4 cloves of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], chopped
*29 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] beef [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
*1 large green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], stemmed, seeded, and chopped
*3 large russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]], cubed bite-sized
*14.5 oz canned diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] in juice
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
*⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]], [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]], [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] and [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]] to taste (about 2-2½ tablespoons total)

==Procedure==
#In a large, heavy pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Dump onions, garlic, bell pepper and seasonings into heated oil.
#When the bell pepper starts to discolor, add the ground beef, stirring to break up large pieces. Brown evenly, cooking for about 7 minutes.
#As meat is browning, add potato, beef broth and diced tomatoes. 
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] until picadillo thickens, stirring occasionally.
#Serve hot with Spanish (Mexican) rice and tortilla.
